startUrls.title: Hotel URLs
startUrls.description: Hotel detail page URLs on TUI to scrape reviews from.

maxReviewsPerHotel.title: Maximum number of reviews per hotel
maxReviewsPerHotel.description: Maximum number of reviews to scrape per hotel

cutoffDate.title: Cutoff date
cutoffDate.description: Only keep reviews on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Interpreted as a local date, assumed to be in the Europe/Berlin timezone — TUI does not expose timezone information. Leave empty to scrape all available reviews.

alwaysReturnSummary.title: Always return a summary
alwaysReturnSummary.description: Whether to always return a summary of hotel reviews, even if no reviews were found.
